sections.content: Use es *necesario* *que*, es *importante* que, *hace* *falta* que and other necessity expressions with the subjunctive. Use the infinitive when the subject remains general or the same.

items.spanish: Es necesario que la sociedad se adapte.
items.english: It is necessary for society to adapt.

items.spanish: Es importante que mejoremos la educación.
items.english: It is important that we improve education.

items.spanish: Hace falta que cambien algunas cosas.

items.english: It is necessary to improve the system.

sections.content: Compare the last example with the others: es *necesario* *mejorar* el sistema uses the infinitive because no specific subject is named, while que la *sociedad* *se* *adapte* names one and switches to the subjunctive.
